name: Nicholas Horbaczewski
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, Drone Racing League; co-founder and board member, Performance Drone Works (PDW)
profile: Former chief revenue officer of Tough Mudder who founded the Drone Racing League in 2015, a pro FPV league broadcast on ESPN, NBC and Sky that built its own drones, radios and simulator. DRL's tech and team seeded Performance Drone Works, which he co-founded with Ryan Gury, Matt Higgins and Trevor Smith and which now supplies C100 drones to the US military.
interesting_fact: DRL built a proprietary radio system so its identical, in-house drones could race at 80+ mph through big venues, even through eight feet of concrete, so that 'when you saw a pilot win a race, you knew that was the best pilot, not necessarily the person flying a faster drone.'
deep_cut_fact: To build DRL's in-house tech team he bought a small drone company called DroneKraft. In 2018 DRL also launched the AIRR autonomous-drone racing series with a $1M prize for AI that could fly the courses with no human pilot.

name: Bam Azizi
current_role: CEO & Co-founder, Mesh (Mesh Connect Inc.), crypto/stablecoin payments network
profile: Bam Azizi, PhD, co-founded Mesh in the Bay Area in 2020 with Adam Israel (CCO). Mesh is a payments network that connects exchanges and wallets so users can pay, deposit and on/off-ramp with crypto and stablecoins; it has 100+ staff across the US, Europe, India and LatAm and is valued around $1B.
interesting_fact: In Oct 2026 Mesh partnered with Visa to make stablecoin and crypto balances spendable at 175M merchants with no separate card. Azizi's line: 'your money should be spendable right where it already lives.'
